summary: Frontend-only verification of the flagship 'Cobot Ultrasonic Welding Automation' case study after switching to 5 REAL locally-served /projects/*.jpg photos. All 6 flagship modal images (hero + 4 single-layout galleries + Final Integrated System) load successfully with naturalWidth>0. All 11 required text sections are present and appear in the exact expected order. Single-layout portrait galleries render with object-contain at ~620px tall (not cropped to a thin strip) and each has both its section title and figcaption. All three close paths (modal-close-btn, modal-scrim@10,10, Escape) work, and body scroll locks/unlocks correctly. Regression sweep passes: flagship project card cover loads /projects/cobot-welding.jpg, the other 3 project cards still load, About timeline (0..5) all render, all 4 Contact links present, and all 8 drone-photo tiles load. No broken images or regressions detected.
critical_code_review_comments: ProjectModal GalleryBlock single-layout uses `w-auto max-h-[620px] max-w-full object-contain` inside a `flex items-center justify-center` container — portrait photos (aspect ratios 900x1600 and 1200x1600) render at ~349-465 x 620 px on desktop with pillar-boxing rather than cropping. Confirmed visually and via computed style.

The 5 real photos at /projects/*.jpg return HTTP 200 with content-type image/jpeg from the frontend origin. Natural dimensions: cobot-welding 900x1600, cobot-fixture 1200x1600, cobot-holder 900x1600, cobot-process 1200x1600, cobot-cad 900x1600. All portrait.

Modal hero image uses `object-cover` on a 420px-tall container — with a 900x1600 portrait source this crops the top/bottom significantly. Currently acceptable because the important subject sits in the center of cobot-welding.jpg, but if any of the other 4 photos are ever swapped in as the hero, review this crop.

Sections appear in the exact order specified by the request: Overview → The Challenge → My Role & Ownership (bulleted, 7 items) → Fixture & Table Development → Welder Holder / Gripper Design → Venturi Vacuum / Suction & Part Presentation → CAD & Cobot Programming → Testing & Learning → Final Integrated System → Final System & Outcome → Lesson Learned (highlighted block).
PROFILE.linkedin still points at the LinkedIn root ('https://www.linkedin.com/') — pre-existing minor content item, not a regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT tester notes: (1) Section labels like 'Overview'/'The Challenge' render with CSS `text-transform: uppercase` — use element.textContent (not innerText) to preserve original case when asserting section presence. (2) Escape close works but requires `window.focus()` before pressing, plus ~1000ms wait for AnimatePresence exit animation. (3) modal-scrim close works when clicking OUTSIDE the panel — use page.mouse.click(10,10). (4) Modal inner-panel is the real scroll container (overflow-y auto, scrollHeight ~6258 vs clientHeight ~970 on 1920x1080) — scroll it programmatically to trigger loading='lazy' images. (5) All 5 flagship images: /projects/cobot-welding.jpg (used twice — hero + Final Integrated System), cobot-fixture, cobot-holder, cobot-process, cobot-cad. (6) hero-featured-chip opens the same flagship modal as project-card-cobot-ultrasonic.
